g.text: The common decision cap did not produce equal realized work

g.text: Every task × replicate point is shown. Blue:20b; orange:23b. Circles:r1; open squares:r2; open diamond:censored T/20b/r2 prefix.
192 is an upper bound (3 decisions ×64 search candidates), not a required workload. Explicit submissions and constructions evaluate fewer candidates.
Duplicate fractions count repeated schedules among valid candidate records; identity is narrower than general DAG isomorphism. Primary runs/v2 only; no browser or v1 pooling.
